name: check_availability
description: Check whether a table is free for a date, time and number of guests. If it is not, the reply has the nearest alternatives. Call this before you offer or confirm any booking, and never say a table is free until it has said so.

date.description: The date as YYYY-MM-DD, in London. Work it out yourself from today's date in your instructions, for example 'next Friday' or 'tomorrow'.

weekday.description: The day of the week. If the caller named a weekday, give exactly that one. If they said 'tomorrow' or gave a date, give the weekday of that date. The server uses it to catch a wrong date.

time.description: The start time as HH:MM on the 24-hour clock, London time, for example 20:00. 'Eight' for dinner is 20:00.

party_size.description: The number of guests, as a whole number.
